description:
`msg-to-mailbox` delivers HTTP `msg` notifications to the caller's verified UnitySVC mailbox.

The gateway composes an email from the `title`, `body`, `type`, and `format` fields and sends it from the platform's svcpass.com domain using the gateway-native `notify://email` primitive. The destination is the required platform-managed `${ customer_secrets.__PRIMARY_EMAIL }` secret, so customers cannot self-assert a recipient.

Use the `default` channel at the canonical gateway URL. No enrollment parameter, SMTP server, or email-provider API key is required; users without `__PRIMARY_EMAIL` fail closed.
name: msg-to-mailbox
summary: Accepts an HTTP request in the unified `msg` format and delivers it to you as email, using a pre-configured destination — no SMTP server or email-provider API key of your own required.

request.template: {"to":["${ customer_secrets.__PRIMARY_EMAIL }"],"title":{* _escape_json(_body.title or "") *},"body":{* _escape_json(_body.body or _body.message or "") *},"type":{* _escape_json(_body.type or "info") *},"format":{* _escape_json(_body.format or "text") *}}
